prototypeNotes: Unspecified ranges/world units/radii/knockback are editable local prototypes, not official. Flameshot linear travel/12. Retribution boot blessings use the explicitly classic role-equipment module; lane maps have no spawned jungle camps. Revitalize follows caster; healing/shield received multiplier max1.25. Vengeance uses actual HP damage after defenses/reduction/shields.

spells.name: Execute
spells.ability: True damage: 100 + 10 × hero level + 13% lost HP. Ignores shields. Kill reduces remaining cooldown 40%.
spells.strategy: Finish injured enemy heroes; confirm the range and missing-HP bonus.

spells.name: Retribution
spells.ability: 750 + 150 × hero level True Damage to minion/creep. Creeps: +60% rewards, -40% basic creep damage. Actual configured allied jungle region: -15% damage for first 2min. No shared minion rewards for first 5min. Selected compatible jungle boots unlock their distinct blessing after 5 real creep/hero kills or assists; at 15, +10 Physical Attack, +10 Magic Power, +100 max HP while those boots remain valid. Lane maps do not spawn camps; minion kills do not advance the upgrade.
spells.strategy: Choose one jungle intention in Preparation, equip Retribution and buy boots; no free standalone blessing purchase. Actual hero kills/assists can advance the lane prototype. Classic rules and source conflicts are documented.

spells.name: Inspire
spells.ability: Up to 8 successful basics in 5s: ×1.5 attack speed, 500% cap, ignore 8% + 1% per hero level defense, heal 60 per hit.
spells.strategy: Use before sustained basic attacks; rejected attacks and misses do not spend charges.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.ability: +50% movement speed and slow immunity for 6s; removes the active slow.
spells.strategy: Escape or pursue without being held by slows; no damage immunity.

spells.name: Revitalize
spells.ability: For 4s, nearby allied heroes heal 2.5% max HP every 0.4s and receive 25% increased healing/shield effects. Aura bonus does not stack.
spells.strategy: Group within the visible spring; allies outside its radius lose its effects.

spells.name: Aegis
spells.ability: Gain a shield of 750 + 90 × hero level for 5s. Shield absorbs damage, not permanent HP.
spells.strategy: Absorb incoming burst. Execute can bypass shields.

spells.name: Petrify
spells.ability: Nearby enemies take 100 + 15 × hero level magic damage, stun 0.8s, then 50% slow for 0.8s.
spells.strategy: Interrupt nearby heroes and set up follow-up attacks; control immunity is respected.

spells.name: Purify
spells.ability: Cleanse removable debuffs except Suppression, gain control immunity and +15% movement for 1.2s. Cannot activate under Suppression.
spells.strategy: Escape stuns/slows; it does not prevent damage or remove Suppression.

spells.name: Flameshot
spells.ability: Directional projectile: 200–680 magic damage, linearly scaled with actual travel distance, first hero/creep hit. Knockback nearby enemies.
spells.strategy: Aim at distant heroes for maximum damage or disrupt nearby attackers; lane minions are not creep targets for this spell.

spells.name: Flicker
spells.ability: Blink 3.5 world units safely along the aim, stopping before walls/bounds; +5 + hero level hybrid defense for 1s.
spells.strategy: Reposition or escape through open gaps, never through solid walls.

spells.name: Vengeance
spells.ability: For 3s reduce incoming damage 35%, reflect 35% of actual post-mitigation HP damage as magic. Reflection cannot reflect again.
spells.strategy: Survive focused attacks and punish living valid attackers. Shields reduce the HP damage used for reflection.

spells.name: Arrival
spells.ability: Channel 3s to an existing allied tower/core/minion, then +60% movement decaying over 3s. Interrupted channel refunds 30s of cooldown.
spells.strategy: Choose a living allied destination; movement, damage, death, casting or target loss interrupts. Traps are unavailable in this project.
